title: recon local.toml
description: Machine-specific paths. Never committed: this is where absolute paths and compiler installs live.

root.description: Directory the profile's tool paths are relative to. Optional: without it, cc and link are absolute paths or bare command names looked up on PATH, which is how a Linux toolchain installed by the distro is used.

cc.description: Compiler to use instead of the profile's compile.exe; absolute, or relative to root.

link.description: Linker to use instead of the profile's link.exe; absolute, or relative to root.
